notes.title: Update V 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello Everybody,

- Now your astronauts in other planets are able to generate you money while you are away from the game. You can collect the generated money the next time you run the game.

- Added a new spaceship (with 7 body parts)

- Added another planet to the game for you to explore! Now you can switch between available starting planets to further continue your journey into space!

- Added new background textures for the earth and mars planets.

- Little bug fix

Thank you for your support !
>Rewindapp
